proposal.label: needs more info
proposal.comment: Could you provide details about how you built or obtained `duckdb.dll` and how you compiled/linked your C++ program (compiler, flags or CMake command, and whether you target x86 or x64)? Also please include whether you used a prebuilt DLL or built DuckDB locally, the runtime (MSVC/MinGW) and the full exception stack trace or crash log produced when running the sample code. These environment and build/linking details are needed to reproduce and diagnose the access violation.
proposal.rationale: Report includes a minimal C++ snippet but lacks essential build/link and runtime details (how `duckdb.dll` was produced/obtained, compiler/runtime, target architecture, and crash stack trace), which are required to reproduce and investigate an access violation on Windows.
